pages.text: A fresh Oak, Birch, Bamboo, Spruce, or Acacia Barrel can be seasoned by alcohol.$(br2)Use Brew or Spirit whose Primary Aroma is level 5 or higher. Five bottles with the same Primary Aroma must finish aging in that barrel.

pages.title: Seasoning Result
pages.text: A listed special combination creates its Unique wood Aroma. Any other Primary Aroma replaces the fresh wood Aroma directly.$(br2)Example: Oak + Red Grape → Red Grape Barrel.$(br2)Liqueurs do not count toward seasoning. Once seasoned, a barrel keeps its Aroma.
